name: Vigorous
description: Bursting with health and vitality, <name> is never sick for long.

name: Robust
description: <name> appears unassailable, bouncing back swiftly from injuries that would put others in the grave.

name: Infirm
description: Fragile health is a burden that <name> has always had to bear. [He/She] is often convalescent.

name: Moribund
description: <name> often has an unwholesome smell, emanating from foetid bandages. [He/She] is slow to heal when injured.

name: Night Owl
description: <name> feels most alive working during the hours of darkness. [He/She] can survive happily with very little sleep.

name: Forty Winks
description: <name> only needs to shut [his/her] eyes for the briefest of cat naps to feel fully restored.

name: Somnolent
description: <name> loves nothing better than a nice, long snooze. In fact, [he/she] needs more sleep than most just to function.

name: Early Bird
description: <name> relishes getting to work at daybreak, when the first cock crows. An early bedtime is essential.

name: Stout
description: <name> jokes that [his/her] ample belly is a great asset, storing energy for lean times. Getting around is slower, though.

name: Gluttonous
description: Food, glorious food! <name> simply loves to eat, whenever, and wherever possible.

name: Iron Stomach
description: One of <name>'s favourite tricks is eating horseshoe nails or soap. It's a special talent to be able to eat literally anything.

name: Gourmet
description: Ah, la joie de cuisiner! <name> is everyone's favourite cook, with endless culinary skills that tantalise the tastebuds.

name: Austere
description: <name> has mastered discipline and self-denial. [He/She] often fasts, going for days without food with no ill effect.

name: Gobbler
description: The only way to preserve food is to eat it, quickly. At least that's what <name> thinks.

name: Congenial
description: Out of sight, out of mind, that's <name>'s motto. [He/She] doesn't worry about things beyond [his/her] control.

name: Outgoing
description: <name> is a great sport, always setting up bouts, games and sing alongs. [He/She] is a jolly soul.

name: Churl
description: Mean and surly, barely even civil. <name> is hard to work with and harder still to befriend.

name: Contemplative
description: <name> spends most of [his/her] time with [his/her] own thoughts. The rest of us are not invited.

name: Industrious
description: <name> is certainly a busy bee, buzzing around getting things done from dawn til dusk. [He/She] never seems to rest.

name: Lord of Misrule
description: For some, tricks and buffoonery were a midwinter indulgence, but <name> liked to play jokes all year long.

name: Hedonist
description: Without a bit of excitement, <name> quickly gets bored, and starts causing trouble. Quite the drama queen.

name: Listless
description: <name> tends to mope about complaining, and is a total wet blanket if anything fun is suggested. [He/She] generally isn't invited.

name: Benevolent
description: <name> is a ray of hope in an otherwise bleak existence. [He/She] makes everyone feel better.

name: Ruthless
description: <name> is extremely candid, and doesn't suffer fools gladly. Those who can't handle the unvarnished truth tend to steer clear.

name: Brawler
description: Whenever a fist fight breaks out, you can guarantee that <name> started it.

name: Disfigured
description: After the fire, <name> did not really have a face, but [he/she] had a purpose. Few will look <name> in the eye.

name: Ill-favoured
description: <name> was born with a boss eye, which made it difficult to know where to look when speaking to [him/her].

name: Winsome
description: Everyone loved <name>: the shy and the bold, knights, children, young and old. [He/She] was beautiful to behold.

name: Fair
description: Who is the fairest of them all? <name> of course! [His/Her] natural charm makes it very hard for anyone to say 'no'.

name: Ravishing
description: Of all the flowers in <village_name>, <name> bearest the prize. [He/She] is as bonny and blithe as a summer breeze.

name: Swigger
description: It's thirsty work! <name> likes to drink on the job, and it makes [him/her] work faster.

name: Punch Drunk
description: If you share alcohol with <name>, expect a black eye, or worse. [He/She] is an angry drunk.

name: Lightweight
description: <name> really cannot hold [his/her] drink. Even a tiny tipple will make <name> doze off.

name: Heat resistant
description: Even in scorching conditions, <name> can take the heat. [He/She] loves working in the sun.

name: Cold hardy
description: <name> seems impervious to the cold. [He/She] works on throughout the harshest days of winter.

name: Hot-blooded
description: <name> seems to be permanently overheated, throwing open windows and shunning warm clothes. [He/She] should be kept cool.

name: Chilly
description: <name> always complains of draughts and chills, and huddles close to the fire. [He/She] must be kept warm.

name: Vulnerable
description: <name> suffers constantly from gout or flux, rashes or spasms. [His/Her] constitution is decidedly feeble.

name: Elf Shot
description: Excruciating back pains that <name> endures were doubtless caused by fairy arrows. What had [he/she] done to deserve such misery?

name: Green Thumb
description: <name> has always loved plants...sometimes better than people. [He/She] tends them, and they thrive.

name: Strapping
description: <name> is as strong as an ox. [He/She] is always hale and hearty, and never laid low.

name: Wicche
description: <name> is highly attuned to the natural world. [He/She] listens closely to the feral whispers of plants and animals.

name: Ascetic
description: <name> has mastered discipline and self-denial. [He/She] shuns comfort, preferring the austerity of a cold, bare cell.

name: Dainty
description: <name> needs the finer things in life to thrive. [He/She] struggles to cope with little things like dirt, cold and hardship.

name: Precious
description: <name> is thin skinned, delicate and nervy. It is important to keep [him/her] comfortable.

name: Whirlwind
description: <name> runs like the wind, fleet as a deer. [He/She] also walks at quite a clip.

name: Fleet Footed
description: It always feels as though <name> is one step ahead. [His/Her] long legs and rapid stride are the reason.

name: Brawny
description: <name> is powerful and carries out tough jobs effortlessly.

name: Sluggardly
description: Always tardy, always tired. <name> is short on punctuality and is slow to get things done.

name: Laggardly
description: <name> struggles to keep up. [He/She] lags behind the others, and takes longer than most to perform the smallest task.

name: Hefty
description: <name> is exceptionally large, practically a giant in fact. [He/She] is not built for speed.

name: Sun Seeker
description: <name> comes alive when the sun is shining. A few golden rays is all it takes to bring out the best in [him/her].

name: Snow White
description: <name> loves nothing better than the biting air and crisp frost of midwinter. [He/She] thrives in the cold.

name: Washout
description: If there are rainclouds about, <name> is going to be very unhappy. Getting wet makes [him/her] as miserable as sin.

name: Dullard
description: It takes <name> a long time to catch on to things, and [he/she] requires a lot of patience. Even then, <name> may not understand.

name: Wise
description: <name> often sees things from a new angle, and thinks differently from most. [He/She] is a problem solver.

name: Erudite
description: <name> has a rare intellect, and could even be called gifted. [He/She] learns extremely quickly.

name: Bloodlust
description: <name> comes into [his/her] own in a fight, roused by the prospect of violent slaughter.

name: Callous
description: <name> is unmoved by human mortality. Flesh is a mere commodity, once the soul has fled.

name: Cannibal
description: <name> is a merciless butcher and devourer of men. [He/She] is fortified by human flesh.
